names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 22 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Ιωάννης ο Βλαδίμηρος ο βασιλεύς και θαυματουργός», with «Άγιος» and the two rank words left off; the second name is kept because the page's own body carries it — «Ο Άγιος Μάρτυς Ιωάννης του Βλαδιμήρου».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 22. мај ст. ст., „Свети мученик Јован Владимир, краљ српски.“ — Свети is not a rank, мученик is the `martyr` this corpus puts in `types` and „краљ српски“ is the `king` it puts there too; strip them and the fullest form the calendar gives is left. **Владимир is kept because it is a second personal name and not a rank or a see**, and because the body uses the two names separately — „дозва на превару Владимира“ — so the heading’s pair is the fuller form. Keeping it also keeps this folder out of the nine-wide bare «Јован» fold that `john-of-gothia` had to join on 19 May, which was measured and not assumed: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Јован Владимир» and nine holders of a bare «Јован». The Greek form on this folder, «Ιωάννης ο Βλαδίμηρος», is the same pair of names.

The heading of the calendar’s name link 1027, «Мученик Иоанн-Владимир, князь Сербский», with the rank word before the name and the rank and country after it left off; the day’s own line gives the same double name in the genitive, «Иоанна-Владимира». The hyphenated pair is the calendar’s own and is kept whole: both its readings use it in their titles and in their body text. `fk.mjs` returned NONE for the form before the write.

birth.note: saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Μάρτυς Ιωάννης του Βλαδιμήρου γεννήθηκε τον 10ο αιώνα μ.Χ. στο Βλαδιμίρ της Βουλγαρίας και έζησε κατά τους χρόνους του αυτοκράτορα Βασιλείου Α' του Μακεδόνος (867 - 886 μ.Χ.).» The page's own two statements do not agree — a tenth-century birth cannot fall in a reign it dates to 867-886 — and neither is corrected here.

death.note: saint.gr: «Κατά την επίσκεψή του ο Άγιος Ιωάννης δολοφονήθηκε με ύπουλο τρόπο το 1015 μ.Χ.», and its head line reads «(; - 1015)».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 22 мая ст. ст. — «Мч. Иоанна-Владимира , кн. Сербского (1015).»

attestations.note: The identification needs no reading: the day line gives the double name, the Serbian princedom and the year 1015 this folder’s `dates` already holds, and the folder’s Greek and Serbian rows keep the same man on the same Julian day. The entry’s link is an index, id1027, serving two readings. `dates` is unchanged: the folder holds a tenth-century birth and a death of 1015, and the second reading says «родился в Х веке» and «изменнически убит 22 мая 1015 года», which agree with both. WHAT THE RUSSIAN ADDS TO THE DEATH IS THE DAY, 22 мая, the day of this feast, and it is in the paragraph and not in `dates`, the schema’s interval carrying years only. HIS OWN PAGES LIST A SECOND DAY: «Дни памяти: 22 мая , 30 августа (Серб.)». The 30 августа is marked by the calendar itself as the Serbian local day, is not repeated by this day page and is not thirteen days from it; one row per church is the schema, so it is recorded here and he does not render on it. THE TWO READINGS DISAGREE ABOUT HIS GRADE AND NEITHER WAS WRITTEN INTO `types`: the day line and the second reading call him «Мч.», martyr, which this folder already holds, while the first reading’s title calls him «великомученик», great-martyr. `king` already stands on this folder off the Serbian «краљ српски» and the Russian’s «кн.», prince, was not written against it. What the Russian adds and the paragraph carries: the two readings’ account of his rule over Illyria and Dalmatia, the fight with the Bogomils at home and with invaders from outside, his building and endowing of churches, the imprisonment and the angel’s word that he would be freed and yet suffer a martyr’s death, the marriage to Косара daughter of the Bulgarian tsar Самуил, the summons to the Bulgarian tsar Иоанн-Владислав under pretext of negotiations and the murder at the door of the church, Косара’s shutting herself up in the church her husband had built, and the relics. THE TWO READINGS NAME TWO DIFFERENT PLACES FOR THE RELICS — «в его монастыре близ Аблазона» and «близ Элбосани» — and neither was chosen. azbyka.ru was not read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ας Μαΐου — «Άγιος Ιωάννης ο Βλαδίμηρος ο βασιλεύς και θαυματουργός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The corpus keeps no folder for him: its fourteen Vladimirs are Russian, `vladimir-the-great` of Kyiv among them, and none is this ruler of the Serbs killed in 1015. The page calls him βασιλεύς and θαυματουργός in its line and Άγιος Μάρτυς in its body, names his father Neeman son of Symeon the first king of Ochrid and his mother Anna, and names Nicholas bishop of Ochrid as his teacher, Bishop Eulogius nowhere; none of those three has a folder. No hymn, no relics named.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 04.06.2026 (22. мај ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик Јован Владимир, краљ српски.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, on the same menologion 22/5 the Greek row already carries, and **a king of the Serbs read in the Serbian book, so this entry is the nearest thing to a primary source this folder will get.** saint.gr’s account is one paragraph and this one is a reign. **`dates` untouched**: the Prologue’s „посече 1015. године“ is exactly the `death` of 1015 the folder already holds off saint.gr’s head line, so there is nothing to widen; and **this book gives no year of birth, so the `birth` of „10th century“ stands with the contradiction its own note records** — saint.gr dating a tenth-century birth into a reign it puts at 867 to 886 — which this reading can neither close nor worsen. **`virgin` IS REFUSED, AND IT IS THE 16 MAY REFUSAL IN A SHARPER FORM.** „Као владар мудар, милостив, кротак, **девствен** и храбар“ — virgin is plainly said of him, and Девица maps to `virgin` in BRIEF-SERBIAN.md §5. **But `src/lib/honorific.js`’s `PRECEDENCE` tests `martyr && virgin` for `virgin-martyr`, second in the whole list**, so adding it to a folder that already carries `martyr` would print **Virgin Martyr John Vladimir** over a Serbian king — a title the Church does not give him and which no calendar read for this corpus prints. **So it is not added, and the virginity is in the prose.** This is the second rank refused in the wave for what it would print, after `monk` on `nicholas-the-mystikos` on 16 May, and the first where the refused word is plainly in the source. `king`, `martyr` and `wonderworker` are all held and all three are corroborated here: „краљ српски“, „посече“, and the numberless wonders at the relics. **New here, and nearly the whole of it**: that he was **of a princely family, out of Захумље**; that **his grandfather was Хвалимир and his father Петрислав**; that as a ruler he was **wise, merciful, meek, virgin and brave**, prayed earnestly and **built and helped churches of his own will**; that he had **hard struggles within against heretics and Bogomils and without against the emperors Samuel and Basil**; that **Samuel took him by a trick and threw him in prison**, and that **an angel of God appeared to him there and foretold that he would soon be freed but would end a martyr all the same**; that **Samuel came to know him better, came to love him, and gave him his daughter Косара to wife**; that **when Samuel died his son Радомир reigned, and Radomir’s cousin Владислав killed Radomir and then called Vladimir to him by a trick and cut him down too**; that **his relics rest incorrupt in his monastery near Elbasan** and have worked numberless wonders through the centuries; and that **a church was raised to him in 1925 at the monastery of Saint Naum, as its ktitor**. **SEVEN PEOPLE NAMED AND NOT ONE GAINS A FOLDER OR A ROW, BY RULING 3.** Хвалимир, Петрислав, Косара, Радомир and Владислав are a grandfather, a father, a wife, a brother-in-law and a murderer, and **the first four are kinships the body narrates, which is the test that owes a row** — but no calendar read for this corpus keeps any of them, `ls saints | grep -iE 'kosara'` returns nothing, and the coordinator’s third ruling forbids minting a folder. **Цар Самуило is the same emperor of the Macedonians who carried Achillius’s relics to Prespa in this wave’s 15 May entry**, and he has no folder there either; цар Василије is Basil II and has none. All seven are in the prose, unlinked, with no rows. **And Saint Naum takes no row**: `naum-of-ohrid` is in the corpus, but a church raised to this king at that monastery in 1925 is **a dedication, and a dedication is not a relation** — BRIEF.md §4’s ruling, applied as it was to Saint Sava’s image on the banners of `theodore-of-vrsac` on 16 May. He is not named in the prose at all, so the linker does not reach him. **A YEAR WITH NO FIELD TO HOLD IT**: the 1925 of that church is neither a birth, a death nor a floruit, the fifth such year in seven days; it stands in the prose. No `locations`, although Zahumlje and Elbasan are named. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Крест, явльшийся тебе с Небесе, светел проповедал еси,/ просветив языки ясно, Владимире славне,/ обагреньми кровей твоих украсився,/ сподобился еси почестей нетленных,/ предстояй Троице,/ тем со дерзновением/ моли спастися нам.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 22 мая ст. ст., «Тропарь мученика Иоанна-Владимира», глас 4 — proper to him, and it names him, «Владимире славне»

english.text: The Cross that appeared to thee from heaven thou didst preach in its brightness, enlightening the nations clearly, O glorious Vladimir; and adorned with the crimson of thy blood thou wast made worthy of honours incorruptible, standing before the Trinity. Therefore with boldness pray thou that we may be saved.

hymns.text: Крест, явльшийся тебе с Небес в блистании, всем проповедал еси,/ просветив языки верно, Владимире славне./ Искуплением же, кровьми твоими возблистав,/ сподобился еси мзды нелестныя, предстоя Троице./ Темже дерзновенно моли Христа спастися нам.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 22 мая ст. ст., «Ин тропарь мученика Иоанна-Владимира», глас 4 — the second troparion the day page prints for him; it is the first one again in another recension, line for line, and it is kept as a separate row because the page prints it as a separate hymn

english.text: The Cross that appeared to thee from the heavens in splendour thou didst preach to all, faithfully enlightening the nations, O glorious Vladimir; and shining forth in thy ransom by thine own blood, thou wast made worthy of a reward that does not deceive, standing before the Trinity. Therefore pray thou boldly to Christ that we may be saved.

hymns.text: Яко сокровище многоценное/ и источник, точащ земным токи,/ недуги очищающий,/ нам подадеся тело твое священное,/ болезнем различным подающе исцеление/ и благодать Божественную притекающим к нему, да зовем ти:/ радуйся, княже Владимире.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 22 мая ст. ст., «Кондак мученика Иоанна-Владимира», глас 8 — proper to him, and it names him, «радуйся, княже Владимире»

english.text: As a treasure of great price, and as a fountain pouring out streams upon the earth and cleansing sicknesses, thy sacred body has been given unto us, granting healing of divers diseases and divine grace to those who run to it; wherefore we cry to thee: Rejoice, O prince Vladimir.
